title: TODO Notifier scan result
description: Output of `todonotifier scan --format json` (the dictionary returned by `ScanResult.to_dict()`). New optional properties may be added without changing `schema_version`; incompatible changes bump it.

root.description: Absolute path of the directory that the file paths of the items are relative to.

generated_at.description: When the scan ran (ISO 8601, with a UTC offset). Its date is the reference day of the status fields of the items.

scanned_files.description: POSIX paths, relative to `root`, of every file that was scanned, including files without TODOs.

items.description: The TODOs found, ordered by file and line.

file.description: POSIX path of the file, relative to `root`.

tag.description: The tag that was matched, as spelled in the `tags` setting, e.g. TODO or FIXME.

message.description: Text after the tag, owner and due date. Untrusted text from the scanned file.

author.description: Person responsible: the `@user` or `TAG(owner)` annotation, else the git blame author. Null if unknown.

due_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if there is none.

due_source.description: Where `due_date` came from: written in the comment as {date} (explicit), computed as the creation date plus `default_due_days` (default), or there is none.

created_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) the line was introduced, from git blame. Null if blame was not available.

is_overdue.description: True if the explicit due date has passed.

is_stale.description: True if the default (computed) due date has passed.

days_past_due.description: Days since the due date if the item is overdue or stale, else 0.

web_url.description: Link to the line in the repository's web UI, or null if the repository URL or the commit is unknown.
